name: GL_ENC_CARRY_FORWARD_ACCTS_
description: GL_ENC_CARRY_FORWARD_ACCTS contains the accounts to be processed for a General Ledger encumbrance balances carry forward. Each row includes the carry forward rule identifier and the account filter. Each account filter stored in this table should be related to one and only one General Ledger encumbrance balances carry forward rule defined in GL_ENC_CARRY_FORWARD_RULES.
